locale.description: Language of every email about this booking, including later ones (approval, refusal, cancellation). Falls back to fr.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, such as DATES_CONFLICT, UNKNOWN_VILLA, VALIDATION, INVALID_STATUS, EMAIL_TAKEN or INTERNAL.

actor_email.description: Email of the admin who made the change; empty when unattributed.

label.description: Where the price came from: a season rule's own name, `Custom` for a per-date override, or `Standard` for the villa's base rate.

price_cents.description: Effective price in EUR cents for that night.

PatchReviewRequest.description: Every field is optional; an omitted field is left unchanged.

PatchSeasonRuleRequest.description: Every field is optional; an omitted field is left unchanged.

nights.description: One entry per day in the requested window, in date order.

PricingSettings.description: Base rate and fees, applied whenever no season rule or per-date override matches. A villa never configured reads back as all-zero rather than 404.

ReviewBreakdown.description: Per-category averages over the villa's approved reviews. A null means no approved review has scored that category yet.

ReviewCategoryRatings.description: Per-category scores for one review. A null means the reviewer did not score that category, which keeps it out of the villa's average rather than pulling it down with a zero.

ReviewMeta.description: The villa's published rating, computed from its approved reviews; nothing here is hand-entered. `display_avg` is 0 when there is no approved review: read `display_count` to tell that apart from a genuine average.

booking_id.description: Null for admin-authored reviews, which have no booking behind them.

featured.description: Pinned to the top of the public reviews section.

meta.description: Free-text context line shown under the author name.

SeasonRule.description: A named, inclusive date range with its own nightly price. When several rules cover the same night the highest-priced one wins.

SubmitVillaReviewRequest.description: What the villa-page form may set, and nothing else: `status`, `featured` and `source` are absent, the review is always stored as `pending`.

info.description: Casa Dana villa rental API. Villa content (names, photos, descriptions) is static in the frontend and not exposed here. Generated from packages/contract: edit the contract, then `bun run --cwd packages/contract generate`.
info.title: Casa Dana API

get.summary: Get the resolved nightly prices for a villa within a date window
get.description: One entry in `nights` per day of the [from, to) window: a per-date override wins over any season rule, the most expensive rule wins when several overlap, and the rest falls back to the base rate. `overrides` lists the raw per-date overrides. The window is capped at 400 days.

post.description: Sets `price_cents` on every date in the body, replacing existing overrides. All dates in one request share the same price.

post.description: For a visitor with no booking of ours. Always created `pending`: it shows in neither the public list nor the meta figures until an admin approves it. The only rate-limited route, as the one unauthenticated write.
